reviewNotes: Held back: not provably public domain: Lyndhurst: public domain needs a death year before 1955, work in print before 1850 ("activeBy"), or "traditional": true for an anonymous source. Imported from CCEH tune 000848 (the melody read from 000848a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1883, the year of the arrangement. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000848a.nwc).
